description: Collapse the current three-step checkout (information, overview, confirmation) into a single page so returning customers can complete a purchase in one submit. Behind the express_checkout flag, tested against both treatments, rolled out to 5% of production users first.

acceptanceCriteria: First name, last name and postal code appear on one page with the order summary
Each field shows an inline error when left blank on submit
The form retains entered values when a validation error is shown
Control treatment continues to show the existing three-step flow
Item total, tax and total are shown before submit
Totals update when an item is removed from the summary
Tax is calculated at 8% of item total
A confirmation message is shown after a successful submit
The cart badge is cleared after completion
Back Home returns the customer to the catalog
The single-page form renders on iOS and Android
The keyboard does not obscure the submit button
Order completion returns the customer to the catalog

stories.summary: Product images on the catalog remain correct
acceptanceCriteria: Each catalog item shows its own product image
No placeholder or duplicate image is served in either treatment
